source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Mechanical V8, p.6-36

procedures.title: Camshaft (V8): measure lobe lift
steps: Install and adjust the valve mechanism.

procedures.title: Camshaft (V8): remove
steps: Remove the fuel pump push rod (Section 6M).
Remove the cam sprocket bolts and take off sprocket and chain together; if the sprocket (a light fit) sticks, tap its lower edge lightly with a plastic mallet.
Thread two 5/16"-18 x 4" bolts into the cam sprocket bolt holes as a handle and draw the camshaft out (see figure 26V in the manual).
notes: CAUTION: all cam journals are the same diameter, so ease the camshaft out carefully to avoid damaging the bearings.

procedures.title: Camshaft (V8): install
steps: Coat the lobes of any new camshaft with Molykote or equivalent.
Oil the cam journals with engine oil and slide the camshaft in.
